R1.summary: Publication Atomic Snapshot for Readers: Immutable AcceptedSnapshot dataclass encapsulates generation, content_hash, catalog_manager, hybrid_index, payload, is_ready. Readers capture a single snapshot reference at request start (snap = get_accepted_snapshot()). Publication performs a single atomic pointer swap under publish_lock. No in-place mutation of active index during build; zero mixed-state reads.

R2.summary: Fail-Closed Browser Automation & Full UI Flow: Zero currentTime assignment fallback. Complete end-to-end UI verification via Chrome CDP: UI form login (no localStorage injection), UI catalog import committing to DB, UI catalog search and navigation, public video frame decode (1280x720) and time advance (+1.17s), pause & resume, scene direct seek 15.0s strictly via selector click (16.42s), 3 sequential timeline seeks (30s, 60s, 115s), episode 2 protected playback with grant token and protected scene seek (21.36s), Google Drive browser playback (1920x1080) and seek (60.0s), and negative control fail-closed assert.

R3.summary: Real Google Drive Playback through Production Stack: Read-only rclone mount to X: (folder ID 1Ypyq-KuQKEhHrWuxtrrR8Y4G7DwbeyZQ); real video file (339,074,277 bytes) served via Spring Boot DriveMediaStorageAdapter with 60s timeout tuning; HEAD 200 OK (Content-Length 339MB), Range 206 1MB start (1,048,576 bytes), Range 206 1MB near-end (1,074,277 bytes); real browser frame decoding (1920x1080) and seek.

DoubleRestartDurability.summary: Two consecutive service restarts (Spring Boot + FastAPI) verifying persistence of H2 DB records, FastAPI accepted snapshot state, search discovery, and Drive media streaming.
